''See also: [[Oth’kimeth Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Oth’kimeth, also known as the Conqueror, is a powerful entity classified as a [[Fiend]]. Originally designated as a [[Class Two Fiend]] during an invasion of an [[Iteration]], the entity's status was elevated to Class One after it began feeding. It is a demonic figure characterized by crimson eyes of ambition and a semi-physical form featuring a crown of bone spikes. Oth’kimeth possesses the ability to manifest as a hulking figure and has been known to taunt its host with memories of past defeats. To prevent the entity's destruction, [[Daruman]] chose to seal Oth’kimeth within himself, acting as a vessel to contain its influence. This containment resulted in [[Daruman]] spending centuries in an [[Abidan]] prison-world, where his will was eventually corrupted by the [[Fiend]], leading to his designation as The [[Mad King|the Mad King]]. [[The Mad King]] wears armor constructed from the physical remains of Oth’kimeth and wields a scythe. While the entity is bound to its host, it can exert influence over [[Daruman]]'s surroundings and servants, and has the capacity to separate from its human vessel or escape into the Void.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This demonic figure possesses a hulking, semi-physical form. Their head is adorned with horns that create a crown of bone tipped in blood, and they possess a single blazing red eye.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Known as the Conqueror, this [[Fiend]] shared moments of laughter with [[Daruman]]. They are currently a presence sealed within The [[Mad King|the Mad King]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Oth’kimeth is a [[Fiend]] that was sealed inside [[Daruman]], also known as [[Mad King|the Mad King]]. The two shared moments of laughter together before Oth’kimeth escaped while [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] was located in the Void.}}
